contract.counting: Displayed text, including rich-text text/link text and raw_number.text. Numeric sorting values, URLs, IDs and application metadata are not text. Plain and data table budgets remain independent.
contract.shape: Ragged rows and partial leading-column settings remain valid.
contract.numeric_display_text: Required and non-empty; no data-table maximum is applied to plain numeric cells.
contract.column_settings: Up to 20 entries; documented null placeholders preserve positions and count toward the maximum.

structural_observations.scope: Authorized stress workspace; auth.test and blocks.validate only. No message writes, rendering or interaction claims.
structural_observations.sparse_null_settings: rejected: must provide an object, despite explicit reference documentation permitting null

decision: Apply the stricter explicitly documented 10000-character rule despite the structural validator accepting over-limit cases. Use the existing cross-language Unicode-code-point convention; count raw_number display text, not its numeric value. Require non-empty numeric display labels where table docs are silent, following the isolated validator response. Retain documented null settings as explicitly requested cross-language wire support, with the validator discrepancy visible in the guide; use default ColumnSettings objects as the compatibility fallback.
availability: Observation date only; no announcement or effective date established.
compatibility: Spec 1.6.0; new native cell role and stricter validation may reject previously constructed over-limit tables. No package release or language-floor change.
